history.recommendation_text: The Board recommends that the Administration work with the United Nations Sustainable Development Group to strengthen the Group’s coordination levy operational guidance to ensure the completeness and accuracy of the contributions subject to levy and that adequate information related to the collection of levies and earmarked contributions is obtained from Group member entities.
history.administration_response: Notwithstanding its limited capacity, the Development Coordination Office has continued to engage with the members of the United Nations Sustainable Development Group and Member States to promote the application of the coordination levy by continuing to raise the matter at every opportunity, including in bilateral meetings with Member State delegations. Further to the update provided in November 2024, the template has been revised and is now being used by United Nations Sustainable Development Group entities. Moreover, the General Assembly, in its resolution 79/258, requested the Secretary-General to explore, with a commitment to increasing, revenue generated by the levy through predictable measures applied equally to donors. The Office is now enhancing its resource mobilization capacity in order to boost close engagement with the Office’s financial management functions on matters relating to the coordination levy and strengthen the coordination levy operational guidance.
history.board_assessment: Given that the Development Coordination Office is now enhancing its capacities with respect to the coordination levy and strengthening the coordination levy operational guidance, the Board considers the recommendation to be under implementation.

history.recommendation_text: The Board recommends that the Administration work with the United Nations Sustainable Development Group to strengthen the Group’s coordination levy operational guidance to ensure the completeness and accuracy of the contributions subject to levy and that adequate information related to the collection of levies and earmarked contributions is obtained from Group member entities.
history.administration_response: The recommendation was implemented. The Administration strengthened coordination levy operational guidance and established robust, institutionalized mechanisms to ensure the completeness and accuracy of contributions subject to levy, as well as the systematic collection of relevant information from United Nations Sustainable Development Group entities. In particular, the Development Coordination Office has formalized a comprehensive, standardized reporting framework capturing cumulative levy receivables across all entities since 2019. This framework is fully integrated into the levy management system and ensures consistent, transparent and complete data. These measures have resulted in measurable improvements, including a sustained decline in receivables and a reduction in the aging of outstanding balances. On this basis, and given that strengthened operational guidance and controls are fully in place and demonstrably effective, the Administration considers the recommendation implemented.
history.board_assessment: Given that Development Coordination Office accounts receivable continue to decline, with most outstanding balances aged less than six months, and that the Office has also developed a comprehensive template to update the cumulative accounts receivable situation on a monthly basis, and strengthen monitoring and follow-up arrangements, the Board considers the recommendation to be implemented.
